note: Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them (via Exophase and PSNProfiles, who agree on all 55). Every guide below is written in my own words for this entry and cites its sources by name and link; a specific location or step with no source earns no credit, so each guide names where its facts come from. Figures that were still unconfirmed on 2026-11-20 are flagged as unconfirmed.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are done — there is nothing extra to do for it. Everything is single-player and offline, one playthrough is enough, and there are no difficulty settings, so plan on roughly 200 hours, most of it on the 100% completion checklist. Keep cheats off the whole run: using a cheat disables trophies and saving. Source: PowerPyx roadmap (200 hours, 1 playthrough, cheats disable trophies); GTABase (55 trophies, all single-player).
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first main mission of Chapter 1, played as Jason. Just play the story; it pops on completion. Source: PowerPyx (automatic story trophy, unlocks after the first main mission in Chapter 1); Push Square (unlocked as part of the story).
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish every main mission of Chapter 1 — PowerPyx notes it pops as the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, begins. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter (15 manual slots exist) because there is no mission replay. Source: PowerPyx (automatic story trophy; manual saves recommended, no mission replay); Push Square (unlocked as part of the story).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish Chapter 2 — PowerPyx notes it pops as the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, begins. Chapter 2 is where the Coffee Break mission unlocks switching between Jason and Lucia, which most later trophies need. Source: PowerPyx (automatic story trophy, Chapter 2; Coffee Break unlocks switching between both characters); Push Square (unlocked as part of the story).
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish Chapter 3 — PowerPyx notes it pops after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Chapter 3 is also where the Andy, Randy and Tyrone questlines and the Yasmani jewelry jobs open up, so take the side quests as they appear. Source: PowerPyx (automatic story trophy, Chapter 3; Andy, Randy and Tyrone questlines open in Chapter 3); Push Square (unlocked as part of the story).
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish Chapter 4 — PowerPyx notes it pops after the final main mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero. The same mission also pops the gold final-mission trophy, so the two arrive together. Source: PowerPyx (automatic story trophy, unlocks after Chapter 4's final main mission, Starting From Zero); Push Square (unlocked as part of the story).
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you complete the final mission (Starting From Zero, the last mission of Chapter 4). After the credits you return to free-roam and the 100% completion checklist unlocks under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion — everything left can be done there. Source: PowerPyx (automatic story trophy, final mission; free-roam continues after the story and the checklist unlocks); Push Square (unlocked as part of the story).
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. Play through the story and it pops on completion. Source: PowerPyx (automatic story trophy, unlocks during Chapter 2 — Breakfast Run); Push Square (story trophy list).
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. Play through the story and it pops on completion. Source: PowerPyx (automatic story trophy, unlocks during Chapter 3 — The Cartel Heist); Push Square (story trophy list).
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. Play through the story and it pops on completion. Source: PowerPyx (automatic story trophy, unlocks during Chapter 4 — Child's Play); Push Square (story trophy list).
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. Play through the story and it pops on completion. Source: PowerPyx (automatic story trophy, unlocks during Chapter 4 — Headliners); Push Square (story trophy list).
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport. Play through the story and it pops on completion. Source: PowerPyx (automatic story trophy, unlocks during Chapter 4 — VCIA Takedown); Push Square (story trophy list).
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. Play through the story and it pops on completion. Source: PowerPyx (automatic story trophy, unlocks during Chapter 5 — Operation Savage Glory); Push Square (story trophy list).
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy and the bulk of the platinum: reach 100% on the in-game checklist (Progress, Stats, 100% Completion), which unlocks only after the story — but progress made during the story already counts. The requirements are lenient, closer to 60% true completion: scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals, do 100 optional missions, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts; only robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need everything. Nothing on the checklist is missable. Source: PowerPyx (100% checklist guide: lenient requirements, counts above, nothing missable); KeenGamer (checklist under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion).
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Mix categories — under-the-bridge flights are the quickest. Track progress by region under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist needs 300 stunts, so this pops on the way there. Source: PowerPyx (250 of 397; category counts; under-the-bridge quickest; tracking via Progress menu and map).
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your count under Touchpad, Progress, Activities, and filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icons). You will do one of each automatically while chasing the other trophies, so don't grind this early. Source: PowerPyx (9 activity types listed; Progress, Activities shows counts; most come automatically).
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 shooting range locations. PowerPyx's dedicated guide lists all 12 locations and all 42 gold medals. The golds are not very difficult, and the ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps the Gunslinger trophy. Source: PowerPyx (all 12 shooting range locations and 42 gold medals; golds not too difficult).
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 drone races in total). PowerPyx's dedicated guide lists every location. Drone races are also required in full for the 100% checklist, so this pops while working on A Long Road. Source: PowerPyx (all 14 Top Fun drone race locations, 42 races; required for 100%).
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique race locations PowerPyx lists. Any mix counts — car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races all feed the activity count, but for this trophy win 20 distinct race events. Source: PowerPyx (all 40 unique race locations); KeenGamer (win 20 different races).
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing location with a purple icon on the map west of Key Lento. Go there and beat him in the fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, so this also feeds Master of None. Source: PowerPyx (Cal texts after Feng Shui; purple icon west of Key Lento).
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish all levels of any one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home with the controllers from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end once, not beat every challenge. Source: PowerPyx (4 games named; first three at home from Chapter 1; finish all levels once).
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's 5-quest optional storyline, which is exclusive to Lucia: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and the finale Puff Puff Pass. It is marked automatically in Chapter 3 — while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. All quests stay available after the story. Source: PowerPyx (Lucia-only; Chapter 3 call and text; all 5 quests named; available after the story).
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving questline: after the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams he calls you and is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. He marks purple treasure-chest icons on the map; dive, use the metal detector to dig the treasure from the ocean floor, and bring it back. He wants 7 shipwrecks cleared in total. Kenton goes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3, so nothing is missable. Source: PowerPyx (7 shipwrecks; metal detector; Kenton unavailable after Chapter 1, returns later).
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's 5-quest optional storyline at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and the finale Hometown Heroes. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. All quests stay available after the story. Source: PowerPyx (marked after Coffee Break; all 5 quests named; available after the story).
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying Strangers & Freaks strands. Only certain questlines count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count as strangers for this trophy. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries); more are still being discovered. All strangers are still there after the story in free-roam, and progress shows on the trophy tracker. Source: PowerPyx (which strands count and which do not; available after the story).
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List: deliver the 16 sports cars he wants. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. Track the list under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List; scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is wanted, then drive it to his garage in west Vice City. Cars in good condition pay more. Source: PowerPyx (16 cars; Key Cloner from Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS; tracking under Map, Robberies).
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's two-quest storyline, which is exclusive to Jason: Take Out Kitty Litter (destroy the Synthetic Labs in Vice City) and the finale Spin On This (shut down the labs). It is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. All of it stays available after the story. Source: PowerPyx (Jason-only; marked after Here, Kitty Kitty; both quests named; available after the story).
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONLY POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations; meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts double, and the last spot needs both characters (after Chapter 2's Coffee Break). Do the Chapter 1 meditation FIRST: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, follows to the balcony, and you choose Accept. That balcony meditation vanishes permanently after Chapter 1, and it is still unconfirmed whether it is required — PowerPyx's author did it and then earned the trophy, so do it to be safe. Source: PowerPyx (18 spots; Chapter 1 balcony meditation missable, unconfirmed if required; final spot needs both characters); GTABase and KeenGamer (only possibly missable trophy).
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Do Bret Vogel's hunting questline, exclusive to Jason: after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break you get a text from Bret marking Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. He gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, then marks hunting spots with purple icons — hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. One clean shot leaves a pristine animal and pays more, but it is not required. It is still being confirmed exactly which animal pops this trophy. Source: PowerPyx (Jason-only; text after Coffee Break; Killtelligence SM-69; exact animal still being confirmed).
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. PowerPyx's dedicated guide lists all 18 set locations. Cards are one of several collectible types; the 100% checklist only needs part of the collectible sets, so pick the three easiest sets near routes you already travel. Source: PowerPyx (all 18 collectible card set locations); KeenGamer (complete 3 sets).
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan any 100 WAiNK locations with the WAiNK app: hold Up to open it, look at a landmark, curiosity or sculpture and hold R1 to scan. There are more than 100 in the world — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags — so scan whatever you pass. WAiNK scanning also discovers vehicles for the Whip It Good trophy. Source: PowerPyx (31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures; more than 100 exist, any 100 count).
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges (8 groups of 10). Track them under Progress, Challenges — the checkmark in the bottom right shows completion. Most complete naturally while working on other trophies, and the 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this pops on the way; leave the hardest 10 for last or skip them entirely. Source: PowerPyx (80 challenges; 50 for this trophy, 70 for 100%; track under Progress, Challenges).
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: First unlock partner free-roam by finishing the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, then call your partner (hold Right and press Triangle). Cause carnage until you reach 4 stars, then escape the red heat zone — a fast sports motorcycle cutting through traffic works, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is an easy escape route because cops and the helicopter struggle to follow. You will likely get this automatically during the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is, which gives 4-star wanted levels. Source: PowerPyx (needs Coffee Break; partner call buttons; train tunnel escape; automatic during bank vault robberies).
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break (Chapter 2) call your partner, then rob 3 robbery targets in a row (green map icons) while staying wanted the whole time — keep the red/blue flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing (Zombix/Adrenaline) from Ammu-Nation. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, available after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs; loot a couple of items and the back-room safe in each. The pop is delayed about half a minute after leaving the third shop — if it doesn't pop, hit a fourth. Source: PowerPyx (needs Coffee Break; 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City; delayed pop; hit a 4th if needed).
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app (hold Up, look at a vehicle, hold R1). You don't need to drive them — scanning is enough. Stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic; the game has 557 vehicles at launch. The 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 base models, so this pops on the way. Source: PowerPyx (557 vehicles; scanning is enough, no driving needed; 200 of 277 for 100%).
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm, then take down 5 enemies before the purple focus bar drains. Buff focus first with food, drinks or a wash/shower at home, and use Adrenaline to extend it (hold L1, press Triangle). Line up 5 enemies at a gang operation, wear body armor, and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. It doesn't seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels and rises via shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier later. Source: PowerPyx (L3+R3 activation; Adrenaline extends it; Duke 556; not on soldiers/police/civilians; 4 focus levels).
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked to a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — not the planes parked on the airfield, it must be connected to a boarding bridge. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, go up the stairs by the boarding bridge, enter the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km away from the airport. Source: PowerPyx (terminals E3/E4 plane; must be docked to a bridge; fly 1 km away).
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military Rhino tank. Find them at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — the tanks stand in the south of the base. Drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, enter a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops. Source: PowerPyx (Mile Zero Air Station, tanks in the south of the base; stunt jump by the south-east entrance).
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks jewelry store robberies (green icons). Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun — never kick the door, that triggers the alarm. Inside, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm in the back room. The trophy pops shortly after leaving. A good location is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City. Source: PowerPyx (Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs; back-door entry; safe code note; destroy footage and disable alarm; Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds).
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner — you can't carry all the cash alone, hand off a bag with Right. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark security vans (purple icons). Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level; escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. The 100% checklist needs all 8, so this pops on the way, and a vault pays up to $205,000. Source: PowerPyx (8 large bank jobs; Yasmani tips $10,000; partner needed to carry cash; up to $205,000 per bank).
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, the same mission that unlocks bank vault robberies — robbing the vault counts as robbing an armored truck. For an earlier method, block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. Source: PowerPyx (automatic in That's Where The Money Is; early method with sticky bomb on a truck near a bank).
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the entire map is visible. PowerPyx's guide names the best plane for unfogging the map fast. Exploring as you travel during the story covers much of it naturally. Source: PowerPyx (fully unfog the whole map; fastest by plane).
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs (39 operations in total). They are marked by yellow icons when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track progress under Progress, Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you robbed. The 100% checklist needs all 39, so this pops on the way. Source: PowerPyx (9 gangs, 39 operations; yellow icons; track under Progress, Gangs).
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it while standing next to the bar with the view. That's the whole trophy — a small breather between the big grinds. Source: PowerPyx (Ocean View Rooftop Bar; Apple Martini; drink it next to the bar).
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. Only this specific blue Banshee counts — it's a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. The pop is slightly delayed and comes after you drive away down the street. Source: PowerPyx (blue Banshee, south Vice City showroom; Key Cloner required; GTA III reference; delayed pop).
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office — bring sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation to blow it. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and it is not missable: if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later and you can grab the rest then. Source: PowerPyx (3 valuables named; sticky bombs for the safe; pops after escaping police; respawns, not missable).
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Have maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. This needs the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break first, so you can switch between both characters. Raise Strength by working out — buy a fitness club membership, filter the map for fitness clubs under Activities, and always bring your partner along (hold Right, press Triangle): while one character works out, the other completes their training too, doubling progress. You can also work out at home after the story. Check Strength under Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, select a character, Strength (heart icon). Source: PowerPyx (max Strength on both at once; needs Coffee Break; partner doubles training; check under Touchpad, Jason & Lucia).
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile: On) — a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action counts. Profiles run Professional (stealthy objectives, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing), Psycho (mass killing) to Irredeemable, which is permanent — avoid Irredeemable, as cops get far more aggressive. It mostly happens passively across robberies and fights; if it is your last trophy, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car. Source: PowerPyx (500 actions; notification setting; five profiles; Irredeemable is permanent).
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — the exact unlock is still being worked out. PowerPyx reports this trophy is currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, possibly robbing it again later in a specific manner; the store is in Vice City, Little Cuba. Don't grind this early: check the cited PowerPyx guide for updates as players crack it, and try the Payday Loans store again in free-roam after the story. Source: PowerPyx (currently unknown; believed related to the Payday Loans store, Little Cuba).
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. At night after 2 AM, go alone to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it isn't there, drive away and come back until it spawns. Follow the path from the car into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it: the UFO drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside to pop the trophy. Source: PowerPyx (road north-west of Starlet Motel, Kelly County; after 2 AM, solo; blinking car; follow the path to the UFO).
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Do it in a crowded area like Vice City or Ocean Beach, where pedestrians are dense enough to chain 10 kicks inside the minute. Source: PowerPyx (any bike, kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds; crowded areas like Vice City or Ocean Beach).
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in Marked Bills through a fence. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total is cumulative across robberies, not in one trip, and bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery. Source: PowerPyx (Dye Pack Jammer from Credit Check; Yasmani pays most; cumulative $250,000; bank vaults up to $205,000).
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shop types. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns at the 24 Ammu-Nations, car mods at the 14 mod shops, and tattoos at the 11 tattoo studios. Clothing (67 stores), footwear, hair and beauty salons and electronics stores all count too. It accumulates across the whole game, so this often pops while buying gear for other trophies. Source: PowerPyx (guns, car mods and tattoos fastest; shop counts listed).
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (there are 4 more story-related garages that don't count). They cost $160,000 in total. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone — buy them through the app. A quick way to fund them is robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4. Source: PowerPyx (8 purchasable garages, $160,000 total; Vice City Real Estate app after Daily Driver).
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses. First buy enough garages (see Little Boxes), because each garage adds parking spots for registered vehicles. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then choose Respray and Register in his garage. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes. Source: PowerPyx (Scooter Bros app after Moses; garages add spots; Respray and Register at Moses; cheap cars to keep costs down).
trophies.name: On the Spot
